scope: Bounded primary-source novelty/licensing screen for a browser-local fixed-point finite-query-edit retrieval application
limitations: Not a systematic review, global novelty certificate, independent mathematical review, journal-quartile verification, or legal opinion
No raw spelling dictionary or corpus downloaded or redistributed by this audit
Recent arXiv sources treated as preprints unless independently verified
No result metrics, published round3 files, or repository root files changed
